cs.t: This $14.88 pair of wireless Bluetooth headphones from Walmart's ONN brand. You'd swear you spent $1000 on a pair of Grado cans. I don't know why they're so good, but they are. I bought 3 pair for backup in case the first fails. I'm convinced it's a COVID anomaly, like upscaling because you can't source cheaper parts, or something similarly unusual.  https://www.walmart.com/ip/onn-Bluetooth-On-Ear-Headphones-B...
cs.th: Ask HN: What are the best-designed things you've ever used?
